sources.entry: noamseg/interview-coach-skill: a Claude Code-based interview coach

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code (or Codex/Cursor) skill that acts as an adaptive interview coach covering job search from JD analysis and resume work through mock interviews to salary negotiation.
summary.what_it_does: The skill is a set of markdown instructions (SKILL.md plus per-command reference files) that turns an AI assistant into an interview coach. It offers 23 commands across application materials (resume, LinkedIn, positioning statement, outreach, application screening answers), interview prep (company research, JD decoding, prep briefs, presentation coaching), practice (drill rounds, full mock interviews), and analysis (transcript parsing, debriefs, progress tracking, feedback capture). Answers are scored on five dimensions (Substance, Structure, Relevance, Credibility, Differentiation), and the coach maintains a storybank of STAR stories with fit scoring. Session state is persisted to a coaching_state.md file so progress carries across sessions. An optional Level 5 directness setting enables a challenge protocol that red-teams stories and transcripts.
use_cases: prepare for a job interview with mock questions and scored feedback
build and organize a storybank of STAR stories
decode a job description and assess fit
optimize a resume or LinkedIn profile for a job search
prepare for salary negotiation and comp conversations
draft networking outreach messages and application screening answers
how_to_run: git clone the repository and cd into interview-coach-skill
mv SKILL.md CLAUDE.md (or mv SKILL.md AGENTS.md for OpenAI Codex)
Open the folder in Claude Code (or Codex) and say 'kickoff'
Share your resume, target role, and timeline when prompted
notable: Five-dimension answer scoring with root-cause diagnosis and adaptive drill branching
Multi-format transcript analysis that auto-detects Otter, Zoom, Grain, Teams, Tactiq, Granola and other formats
Persistent coaching_state.md memory that tracks storybank, scores, and interview loops across sessions
Optional Level 5 challenge protocol with assumption audits, pre-mortems, and red-teamed stories
Application screening answer library saved per company under job-search/
caveats: Requires a paid Claude plan (or a paid ChatGPT plan for Codex), per the README
Depends on an AI assistant with file system access; it is not a standalone app
The README makes many claims about adaptive learning that depend on the assistant following the markdown instructions
